mining.retriever: hybrid RRF k=60 over the same BM25 top-1000 and dense top-1000 lists as the fixed-candidate system, with truncated fusion (a product missing from one list gets rank 1001 instead of its exact full-catalog rank). Changed from exact fusion after the exact version ran at ~1.4 queries/s under memory pressure (before any training data existed); agreement with exact hybrid is measured and recorded.
mining.query_sample: all prepared-train queries (18,756); max_queries null. Raised from a planned 8,000 after a 20-query smoke run showed judged C items are sparse in the top 100 (before any training data or result existed)
mining.policy: A hard negative is a product with an observed ESCI I or C judgement for that TRAIN query that the hybrid retriever ranks within the top mining_k. Labels are never changed; unjudged retrieved products are never used as negatives. Hardest (lowest hybrid rank) first, at most max_per_query_per_label per query per label.

variants.A_balanced_random: Historical data approach: 2,500 random TRAIN pairs per ESCI label (class-balanced, 10,000 rows).
variants.B_hard_negative: Same 2,500 E and 2,500 S rows as A (identical rows); the 2,500 I and 2,500 C rows are replaced by retrieval-mined hard negatives. Same size and label counts as A, so only negative hardness changes.

validation_pairs.source: judged candidates in the hybrid top-40 of VALIDATION queries (from retrieval_per_query.jsonl of the baseline run)

cross_encoder.why: One compact discriminative baseline: a 22M-parameter BERT cross-encoder already trained for query-passage relevance (MS MARCO), fine-tuned with a new 4-way ESCI head.
cross_encoder.input: query [SEP] product_text(title, brand, colour, bullet points, description) truncated to max_length
cross_encoder.head: 4-way softmax over E/S/C/I (new, randomly initialised)
cross_encoder.training_data: both TRAIN variants (A_balanced_random, B_hard_negative), trained separately with identical settings.
cross_encoder.selection: (variant, epoch) with the highest VALIDATION macro-F1 on validation_pairs; frozen before any test evaluation
cross_encoder.ranking_score: expected gain sum_c p(c)*gain(c)/3 in place of gain/3 inside the production formula 0.8*g + 0.2*normalized RRF (pre-registered primary); the argmax-label variant is also reported

test.query_sample: identical to esci-us-heldout-v1 (stable_sample(42) over evaluated test queries); asserted equal to the historical reranking query IDs
test.score_formula: cross-encoder expected ESCI gain with indexed hybrid retrieval as a deterministic tie-breaker
test.pre_registered: The selected cross-encoder is evaluated on test once after training and validation selection are frozen.
